tasks.title: Implement setup_logger with loguru sinks and stdlib interception
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging/ tests/property/logging/ tests/unit/logging/ -v
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/logging/__init__.py exporting setup_logger, logged, logged_class
Implement _setup.py with setup_logger() configuring console sink (stderr, colorize, backtrace) and rotating file sink (UTF-8, enqueue, backtrace, diagnose=False)
Implement idempotency guard using threading.Lock and a threading.Event
Implement _InterceptHandler subclassing logging.Handler to route stdlib records to loguru, skipping frozen importlib bootstrap frames
Install intercept handler on root stdlib logger exactly once
Create the log-file parent directory if it does not exist (EDGE-001)
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging/ tests/property/logging/ tests/unit/logging/ -v
design_constraints: Must be importable without application wiring
Must be safe to call multiple times (idempotent)
Must not leak local variable values (diagnose=False)
completion_gates: All acceptance tests for AC-001 through AC-005 pass
Property tests for INV-001 and INV-002 pass
No new third-party dependencies beyond loguru

tasks.title: Implement @logged and @logged_class decorators
tasks.red_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging/ tests/property/logging/ tests/unit/logging/ -v
implementation_steps: Implement _decorator.py with logged() decorator factory supporting level, slow_threshold_ms, slow_threshold_setting, include_args, context_getter, depth
Implement entry log line with function qualname and (optional) argument representation
Implement exit log line with elapsed time in milliseconds (sync and async)
Implement exception log line with exception type and message, propagating the exception unchanged
Implement slow-threshold escalation to a configurable slow_level (default WARNING)
Implement logged_class() decorator that applies logged() to all public (non-underscore) methods
tasks.green_command: uv run pytest tests/acceptance/logging/ tests/property/logging/ tests/unit/logging/ -v
design_constraints: Must preserve function return values and exception propagation
Must use functools.wraps to preserve function metadata
Must skip private methods (prefixed with _) in logged_class
Must support both @logged and @logged(level=...) usage patterns
completion_gates: All acceptance tests for AC-006 through AC-013 pass
Edge case tests for EDGE-002 and EDGE-003 pass

tasks.title: Implement stub Settings module and public API exports
implementation_steps: Create src/backend/logging/settings.py with Settings class providing log_level, log_file, log_max_bytes, log_backup_count, profiling_include_arguments fields
Implement get_settings() returning a Settings instance with default values

Contract tests for NFR-001 through NFR-004 pass
Type annotations present on all public functions (NFR-003)
